description: For distinct atoms \(p,q\), the singleton true sets \(\{p\}\) and \(\{q\}\) both satisfy \(p\lor q\), but their empty intersection does not.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.nonHorn_intersection_counterexample.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {p q : α}
  (hpq : p ≠ q) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.valuation {p})
      {Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.pos p, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.pos q} ∧
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.valuation {q})
        {Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.pos p, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.pos q} ∧
      {p} ∩ {q} = ∅ ∧
        ¬Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.valuation ∅)
            {Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.pos p, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.pos q}
